block_cost_per_damage.label: Block Cost per Damage
block_cost_per_damage.description: Stamina a blocked hit costs per point of its damage.

stamina_floor.label: Stamina Floor
stamina_floor.description: How far below empty the emptying swing may take the pool.

stamina_regen_delay.label: Stamina Refill Delay
stamina_regen_delay.description: Seconds after the last spend before stamina refills.

mana_per_level.label: Mana per Charge Level
mana_per_level.description: Mana a cast costs per charge level.

mana_regen_delay.label: Mana Refill Delay
mana_regen_delay.description: Seconds after the last cast before mana refills.

poise_fraction.label: Poise
poise_fraction.description: Share of maximum health that must land within the poise window to stagger.

poise_window_seconds.label: Poise Window
poise_window_seconds.description: The window, in seconds, the poise share must land within.

commit_extra_seconds.label: Swing Commitment
commit_extra_seconds.description: How much later than the game a swing may be cancelled, in seconds.

lock_drop_seconds.label: Lock Release Delay
lock_drop_seconds.description: Seconds without a valid target before the lock releases.

parry_window_seconds.label: Parry Window
parry_window_seconds.description: The timed parry's window in seconds (the game's is 1).

cast_recovery_seconds.label: Cast Recovery
cast_recovery_seconds.description: How long a launched spell plants its caster; 0 turns it off.

turn_speed_static.label: Turn Speed Standing
turn_speed_static.description: The hero's turn rate standing, in degrees per second (the game's is 350).

turn_speed_running.label: Turn Speed Running
turn_speed_running.description: The hero's turn rate at full speed, in degrees per second (the game's is 115).

move_friction.label: Movement Response
move_friction.description: How fast the hero's speed follows the stick, per second (the game's is 4).

camera_distance.label: Camera Distance
camera_distance.description: The orbit distance outdoors; indoors is 85% of it.

camera_height.label: Camera Height
camera_height.description: The camera's rise over the focus at the orbit distance.

camera_focus_height.label: Camera Focus Height
camera_focus_height.description: The focus's height over the hero.

camera_lock_tightness.label: Lock-On Tightness
camera_lock_tightness.description: The cosine of the cone a locked target is kept inside (the game's is 0.9).

camera_lock_turn_speed.label: Lock-On Turn Speed
camera_lock_turn_speed.description: How fast the camera turns to keep a locked target in view, in degrees per second (the game's is 250).

ai_attackers_at_once.label: Attackers at Once
ai_attackers_at_once.description: Attack tokens per defender: how many enemies may attack one hero at once.

ai_ring_slots.label: Inner Ring Slots
ai_ring_slots.description: Enemies that may stand in the inner ring around a hero (the game's is 3).

ai_token_seconds.label: Attack Token Lifetime
ai_token_seconds.description: How long an attack token lasts unused (the game's is 3).

ai_gap_fodder.label: Fodder Attack Gap
ai_gap_fodder.description: The most a fodder enemy waits between attack sequences, in seconds.

ai_gap_elite.label: Elite Attack Gap
ai_gap_elite.description: The most an elite enemy waits between attack sequences, in seconds.

ai_gap_boss.label: Boss Attack Gap
ai_gap_boss.description: The most a boss waits between attack sequences, in seconds.

ai_block_chance_fodder.label: Fodder Block Chance
ai_block_chance_fodder.description: Percent chance an unblocked hit makes a fodder enemy raise its guard.

ai_block_chance_elite.label: Elite Block Chance
ai_block_chance_elite.description: Percent chance an unblocked hit makes an elite enemy raise its guard.

ai_block_chance_boss.label: Boss Block Chance
ai_block_chance_boss.description: Percent chance an unblocked hit makes a boss raise its guard.

ai_punish_heal_seconds.label: Heal Punish Window
ai_punish_heal_seconds.description: How long after a hero heals enemies in reach attack as if they held a token.

ai_punish_whiff_seconds.label: Whiff Punish Window
ai_punish_whiff_seconds.description: Up to how long after a missed swing enemies in reach punish it.

ai_punish_cast_seconds.label: Cast Punish Window
ai_punish_cast_seconds.description: How long after a hero's spell launch one more enemy gets a token and comes for them.

ai_close_in_distance.label: Close-In Distance
ai_close_in_distance.description: How close a token holder sprints before it strafes, in metres (a style's own distance, 5 m by default, otherwise).
